diagnosis: The preview endpoint streams the first 2KB of an in-progress tus file upload using uploadId without validating that the authenticated customer created the upload. An attacker can preview the initial bytes (including document headers and plain text content) of files being uploaded by other customers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/tus/preview/up_sensitive_export_9918 HTTP/1.1
Host: storage.drivehub.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
